facts.text: I live in misty mountain forests in China.
Bamboo is almost all I eat, 99 out of 100 bites!
I munch up to 14 kilograms of bamboo every day!
Half the time, a panda mom has twins!
When I was born, I was pink and smaller than an apple!
Panda moms play with their cubs by rolling and wrestling!
I like to spend most of my time alone.
People protect our forests to help keep us safe.

foods.caption: Yum! Bamboo is almost all I eat!
No thanks! Pandas don't eat burgers.
No, thank you! Candy isn't panda food.
Pizza? No thanks, I'll stick to bamboo!

toys.reveal: This wrist bone works like a thumb to hold bamboo!
